Standard asymptotic C(2n,n)~4^n/sqrt(pi*n) fixes limit. Independent newly generated ALL (2n-1)!! source_inspections.trigger: Joint leaf/path-length generating function may subsume exact covariance

value.rationale: Leaf count (plateau count) is a canonical local branching statistic, and total internal path length (aggregate doubled-label nesting) captures global depth. Their exact finite covariance, strict anticorrelation sign and limiting linear drift answer a motivated joint-statistics question that neither marginal distribution supplies. The exact function could calibrate related increasing-tree joint laws, despite a possible alternative derivation from a known general GF.
residual_risks: An already implicit differentiated multivariate generating series may reduce novelty.

final_claim: For all n>=1 uniform ordinary Stirling permutations, Cov(P_n,D_n)=2*4^n/(3*C(2n,n))-(8n+4)/9; zero n1, strictly negative n>=2, ratio to n tends -8/9.
limitations: Ordinary two-copy, uniformly sampled Stirling permutations, not generalized Stirling permutations.
Exact covariance, not complete bivariate generating function or joint limit.
Finite independent enumeration through n=7 is not proof of all n.
